description: This file defines a React context for managing a shopping cart within a web application. It includes a reducer to handle cart actions such as adding, removing, updating items, and clearing the cart, along with provider and hook components for context management.

methods.name: cartReducer(state, action)
methods.description: Reducer function to handle cart state updates based on action types such as add, remove, update quantity, and clear.

methods.name: CartProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component providing cart context to its children, managing cart state.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Function to dispatch an action to add an item to the cart.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Function to dispatch an action to remove an item from the cart by id.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Function to dispatch an action to update the quantity of an item in the cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Function to dispatch an action to clear all items from the cart.

methods.name: useCart()
methods.description: Custom hook to access cart context values.
